QuestInfo.name: Chil Nam's Buckwheat Paste
QuestInfo.0: Apparently, the place that makes the best buckwheat paste in Korean Folk Town is Chil Nam's...
QuestInfo.1: I went to Chil Nam's place because he was apparently the best at making buckwheat paste in Folk Town. He asked for 4 Tiger Stamps and 1,000 mesos in return for some buckwheat paste.\n\n#t4000170# #b#c4000170##k/4
QuestInfo.2: I gave Chil Nam 4 #t4000170#s and 1,000 mesos for 2 buckwheat pastes.

0.0: You are the one that helped us brothers out before, right? How can I help you this time? Please don't tell me you're here at the request of my older brother...\r\n#L0# #bCan I get some buckwheat paste?#k
0.1: Buckwheat paste? Well, you've come to the right place. We make the best buckwheat paste in Folk Town, no question. The thing is, I was just about to leave to get something, and... if you can get me the item, then I'll give you some buckwheat paste.

yes.0: Please get me #b4 Tiger Stamps#k and I'll make the buckwheat paste for you for only #b1,000 mesos#k per.

no.0: Aren't you here because you need some buckwheat paste?

1.0: Wow, you really brought it! Since you have worked hard at bringing me the Tiger Stamps, I'll give you the buckwheat paste as promised. It really tastes good, you know.

yes.0: If you want some buckwheat paste again, then by all means come see me. Please know that it takes me at least 6 hours to make one.

item.0: Please get me 4 Tiger Stamps and I'll make some buckwheat paste for you.
